dialog.en: Check the chest. No, the other chest. You passed it. Go back. I'm not playing, I'm just saying.

dialog.tr: O kapıdan girme, tuzak var. Bilmiyorum, hissediyorum.

ver.en: You handed it over. Your partner walked straight through that door. It was a trap.

coach.en: The feeling was correct. It went unused.

dinle.tr: Her dediğini yaptın. Bölüm iki saat sürdü. Öbür sandıktan bir çift eldiven çıktı.
dinle.en: You did everything they said. The level took two hours. The other chest contained a pair of gloves.

coach.en: Two hours. One pair of gloves.

kulaklik.tr: Kulaklığı taktın. Partnerin yönergeleri işaretle sürdürdü; bir ara ekrana kâğıt tuttu.
kulaklik.en: You put your headphones on. Your partner continued in gestures. At one point they held a note up to the screen.

coach.en: Audio off. The broadcast continues in writing.
